features: Adds shared CountryFlagService for projector display metadata
Competitor, callback and finalist projection tiles now show country flag plus country name when country is available
Supports common BDC country names and ISO two-letter country codes
Unknown country names gracefully show country text without blocking projection
Country and flag remain optional display-only metadata and never affect registration or scoring
Real projector uses the shared flag helper; Test projector remains compatible with optional country data when present
No scoring calculation, results or official BDC points logic changed
No Staging or Production deployment performed
